name: Lumo (Proton)
summary: Proton's private AI assistant that doesn't keep your chats.
description: Lumo, from Proton (Proton Mail, Proton VPN), is an AI assistant that doesn't keep conversations or use them for training. It runs on open-source models hosted in Europe.
summary_fr: Assistant IA confidentiel de Proton, sans conservation des conversations.
description_fr: Lumo, de Proton (Proton Mail, Proton VPN), est un assistant IA qui ne conserve pas les conversations et ne les utilise pas pour l'entraînement. Il s'appuie sur des modèles open source hébergés en Europe.
features_fr: Modèles open source hébergés en Europe
